dialogue.Introduction: Hiya, @! You must be the new face in town. I'm the Party Girl, and trust me, this valley needed more fun yesterday.$h#$b#So what are we celebrating? Anything counts. A good harvest, a Tuesday, a slime that finally stopped bouncing on your porch.$u
dialogue.Mon: Monday already? Nobody told me! Monday is practically a party day if you squint hard enough.$h
dialogue.Tue: Tuesday! Perfect for a little warm-up party, don't you think? Wait, are you wearing confetti? That is a yes from me.$h
dialogue.Wed: Hump day! I have three parties' worth of streamers and one very loud boom box. Time to pick your side.$h
dialogue.Thu: Thursday! Nothing says Thursday like a balloon released over the mountains. Nobody ever stops to see where they land.$u
dialogue.Fri: Friday night! Are you coming out tonight, or will you sit at home like a grumpy cave bat?$h
dialogue.Sat: Saturday, bring the snacks! I need pizza and a barrel of Ale. The Tavernkeep refuses to sell me another barrel, so I'm improvising.$h
dialogue.Sun: Sunday. A quiet day for everyone else, but I'm planning a sunrise sing-along on the beach. Tell the Angler not to be grumpy about it.$h
dialogue.Mon2: Oh, @! Want to come to my trailer tonight? Just a few friends, a little music, and maybe some confetti everywhere.$h
dialogue.Wed2: You want to know a secret? I have been practicing the bus horn dance for weeks. The passengers love it, mostly.$h
dialogue.Fri2: Friday! My feet already hurt from last night, and I would not change a single step of it.$h
dialogue.Sat2: Did you finish the Community Center bundle yet? Don't forget to come dance when you're done with all that hard work.$h
dialogue.Tue2: Tuesday, @. Sometimes I catch myself humming party songs at the bus stop, and the Mechanic asks me to please stop.$l
dialogue.Mon4: Between you and me, I was up all night planning a surprise for the Merchant. Shh. He does not know yet.$h#$b#Don't look at me like that. It's a good surprise. Probably.
dialogue.Tue4: The Clothier told me I dance like a wind-up toy in a stormy room. Coming from a man with a cursed past, I took it as a compliment.$h
dialogue.Wed4: I've noticed you always wave back at me from the bus stop, @. Nobody else bothers. It makes my whole day brighter.$h
dialogue.Thu4: The Nurse keeps telling me to get more sleep. Sleep! As if I could sleep with a whole valley out there waiting to celebrate.$a#$b#Ha! Joking, @. Mostly.$h
dialogue.Fri4: Friday nights at the saloon are my favorite. The Demolitionist sets off a firework, the Guide yells at him, and I get to dance through the whole thing.$h
dialogue.Sat4: The mines are loud, the beach is loud, and the forest is loud in its own way. I like loud. Loud means somebody is having a good time.$h
dialogue.Sun4: I'm glad you're part of this town, @. I worried the valley would be too quiet with all the bosses and blood moons around. You made it fun.$h
dialogue.Mon8: You're the only one in this valley who laughs at my jokes, @. The rest of them just stand there looking sad at the bus stop.$s#$b#Thanks for always showing up. I mean that. Sorry, I got a bit soft there.$l
dialogue.Tue8: Some nights I'm not sure why I throw so many parties. Then you show up, and I remember it's because I like watching people smile.$l
dialogue.Wed8: I used to think parties were only about the music. Now I think they're about who you invite. I'm glad I invited you, @.$l
dialogue.Thu8: The Guide says parties are a distraction from real heroics. I say a hero needs a break now and then, and you look like you need one more than most.$h
dialogue.Fri8: Remember when you first arrived and I thought you were just another tourist? I was wrong. You belong here, and I'm not letting you leave without a dance.$l
dialogue.Sat8: Every party I've ever thrown has a little empty spot in it, for the friend who couldn't come. I hope you never end up in that spot, @.$s
dialogue.Sun8: I'd like you to know that when I'm scared of the dark, I think about your laugh. It sounds silly, but it works every time.$l
dialogue.Sun10: I'm going to say something I've never said before, @. Thank you for being my favorite person to celebrate with.$l
dialogue.Fri10: I used to hide behind the loudest music I could find. With you, I don't feel like I have to hide at all. That is rare, @.$l
dialogue.Tue6: When the lights go down at my trailer, sometimes I still feel a bit lonely. That's silly, right? Here, have a party hat. Don't argue.$h
dialogue.Thu6: I heard the Angler calling the sea monsters a bunch of cowards. Honestly, he is not wrong, but I wish he'd be nicer to them.$h
dialogue.Sat6: Some nights the saloon gets so loud I can't hear myself think. The Tavernkeep says that's good for business. I say it's good for everything.$h
dialogue.spring_Wed: Spring showers make me want to throw a party under the umbrellas. Strange? Maybe. Fun? Definitely!$h
dialogue.summer_Sat: Summer is party season, and the beach is the best place to show it off. Bring sunscreen, and maybe a bit of nerve.$h
dialogue.summer_Tue: This summer sun is so warm I could dance on the sand all day. Honestly, that is exactly what I plan to do.$h
dialogue.fall_Mon: The fall leaves look so good as confetti. Nature really does know what a party is.$h
dialogue.fall_9: Only a few weeks until the Stardew Valley Fair! I already have the streamers ready for the grange, @.$h
dialogue.winter_Fri: Winter is just a longer excuse to dance. I'm not complaining. The cocoa is great.$h
dialogue.winter_Sun8: The valley is cold, but the stars look nice from the bus stop. I sometimes wish I could share them with more people.$s
dialogue.spring_20: Ten days until the Flower Dance! You did remember your dancing shoes, right? I'll be checking.$h
dialogue.winter_20: Only a few days until the Feast of the Winter Star. Keep your secret gift a surprise, @. I'm terrible at keeping mine.$h

rainy: Ugh, rain! Thank goodness my confetti is waterproof, or nobody would ever let me throw a party outdoors.$h

situations.eye: The Eye of Cthulhu is gone, @! I watched the whole thing from the top of the bus stop. Very dramatic, very wet, very good for the party schedule.$h
situations.evilBoss: Something nasty crawled out of the ground last night and somebody finally sent it back down. Let's celebrate that, yes?$u
situations.skeletron: Skeletron is defeated, and the dungeon is open again! The Old Man is free, and so is my dance floor, if I can get some people down there.$h
situations.queenBee: The Queen Bee is gone! The honey will be sweet for a while, and I'll be throwing a party with honey-glazed pizza. Nobody argue with me.$h
situations.hardmode: The Wall of Flesh fell, and now the Hallow is spreading everywhere. Shiny, scary, and very loud. Be careful out there, @.$u
situations.mechs: A mechanical boss was destroyed last night! I heard the explosions from my trailer. Honestly, the whole valley should throw a party for that.$h
situations.plantera: Plantera is defeated! The jungle temple is open now. I'm going to dance in the jungle, and I'd love for you to come.$h
situations.golem: The Golem is down! That stone head was not much of a party guest, but it was a lovely fight, @.$h
situations.cultist: The Lunatic Cultist is gone and the celestial pillars are up. Such a fancy light show. I'd like a party under it, please.$u
situations.moonLord: The Moon Lord is defeated! Nobody saw this coming, and frankly, the whole sky should have a party for it.$h
situations.goblins: The goblin army was pushed back last night. The Goblin Tinkerer is very proud of his old friends, and the Guide is very tired.$h
situations.pirates: The pirates were chased off last night, @. The Pirate looked very annoyed, and I think the beach smells better for it.$h
situations.frostLegion: The Frost Legion is gone for now. Snowmen may be cute, but I'd much rather have a snowy party.$h
situations.martians: The Martian Madness is over, @! Their saucers are gone, and the streets are finally quiet enough for a dance.$u
situations.bloodMoon: There was a blood moon last night! I stayed inside with every lantern lit and didn't dance once. Terrible. Let's make tonight better.$s
situations.eclipse: The sun went dark yesterday during the eclipse. I held a little party in the dark just to see how many people would come. Three! Better than none.$h
situations.party: The Party Girl is throwing a party today! Come to the bus stop with a smile and something to share. That's all I ask.

festivals.spring13: Happy Egg Festival! The egg hunt is my favorite, because nobody can hide an egg from me. Go find the good ones, @.$h
festivals.spring24: The Flower Dance! Everyone is holding a flower and nobody is holding still. Dance with me, @, before anyone else asks.$h
festivals.summer11: The Luau! The community soup is bubbling and everyone is adding something. I brought a pineapple, a bit of pizza, and a whole lot of enthusiasm.$h
festivals.summer28: The Dance of the Moonlight Jellies! The beach is glowing, the music is perfect, and I am dancing my heart out. Join me, @!$h
festivals.fall16: The Stardew Valley Fair! The grange displays are wonderful, and there are so many games. I'm going to win a star token and make a fuss about it.$h
festivals.fall27: Spirit's Eve! The haunted maze is terrifying, but a party in a graveyard is still a party. Just don't let the Tavernkeep scare you.$u
festivals.winter8: The Festival of Ice! Ice fishing with the Angler is a terrible idea, but I'm going to be there cheering on the snow sculptures anyway.$h
festivals.winter25: The Feast of the Winter Star! I'm giving everyone a gift they can't guess, and yes, I already know who I'm giving the best one to, @.$l

loved.text: Oh my gosh, a party in a bottle? You know me too well, @! Thank you, thank you, thank you!$h

liked.text: Ooh, that's perfect for my next celebration! Thanks, @, you always think of the good stuff.$h

neutral.text: Hm, thanks, @. I'll find a party spot for it somewhere in the valley.

disliked.text: Oh... well, thanks for thinking of me, I guess. Maybe keep this one for yourself.$s

hated.text: Ugh, is that Joja? Get that thing away from my trailer, @, before the streamers curl up and die.$a

events.after: The bus will be here soon. Don't miss it, or I'll have to honk the horn outside your house.$h

steps.say: Oh! @, perfect timing. I was just testing the horn. Want to hear it?$h

steps.question: Do you want to hear the horn?

answers.reply: Aww, you're no fun. Okay, later, then.$s

steps.say: Honestly, this bus is the only thing in the valley that never gets lonely. There is always someone in the seats.$h
Here, a little something from my party box. Keep it on your belt for emergencies.$h
Are you here for the dance, @? The Tavernkeep says the floor is only safe for people who can keep up with me.$h
Okay, I'll be honest. I don't dance because I love it. I dance because it keeps the quiet away.$s

steps.question: Do you feel the quiet too?

answers.reply: Then we'll dance it away together, @. Deal?$l
Hmm, fine. Then you'll have to pretend you're dancing with me.$a

steps.say: Okay, enough sad talk. Now dance with me! Everyone is watching.$h

events.after: Don't tell the Angler I cried. He would never let me hear the end of it.$s

steps.say: Shhh, @. Don't tell the Angler I'm out here. He thinks I'm asleep, and I'm not allowed to be grumpy at him.$u
I'm not following anyone! I'm fishing for the biggest fish in the ocean, and I'm not scared of your loud party tricks.$a
Oh, you're fishing at night? That's brave of you, little one.$h
Okay, @, here's the honest part. I told everyone I'd throw one more party before winter. I have a bad habit of making plans and forgetting to finish them.$s
Then do a party with me! I want a fishing contest, a cake, and everybody in the valley invited.$h
Deal! Let's make it the best night the valley has ever seen.$h

events.after: Please don't look at the letters again without me. I'm still embarrassed about them.$s

steps.say: Oh! @, come in, come in. Excuse the mess, I was cleaning up confetti from last night. It gets everywhere.$h
My trailer has a little secret. Behind the decorations is a box of letters from every party I ever held. Nobody came to every one.$s

steps.question: Do you want to see them?

answers.text: Yes, I would love to see.
answers.reply: Thank you. You really mean it, don't you?$l

answers.text: No thanks, I would rather not.

steps.say: Here, look at this one. It says Dear Party Girl, you made my winter feel warmer. Signed, nobody important.$l
Ha, I tell myself I'm not sentimental. Then a letter like this makes me cry into the confetti.$s
You're going to be in the next letter, @. Don't you dare say no to that.$h

events.after: Go get some sleep, @. And save me a dance tomorrow, please.$h

steps.say: @, I wanted to say something big tonight. Please don't laugh.$s
I used to be the loudest person in every room. Then the quiet came, and nobody wanted a party anymore. I thought I had lost my way.$s
But you keep showing up. At the bus stop, the saloon, the beach, and now even my messy trailer.$h

steps.question: What do you think a party is for?

answers.text: Making sure nobody is left alone.
answers.reply: Exactly. That's the whole secret, @. Thank you for knowing it too.$l
Ha! Cake and noise. Fine, you're half right, and I like you for it.$h

steps.say: Here, take this. It's a present from my favorite party. Open it when you're lonely, and then come find me.$l
Now let's go out and dance, @. I want to see your happy face under the lanterns.$h
